description.p: FastSync keeps a folder in sync with Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive or MEGA, both ways, with every file available offline. Log in through your browser, choose the folders, and it runs from the tray.

Changes are noticed straight away: edits on your computer through inotify, and edits in the cloud through each service's own change feed, without listing the whole tree again. If both sides changed a file, both copies are kept. Files removed in the cloud go to a trash folder instead of being deleted, and a run that would delete too many files stops and asks first.
More reliable, and faster with ignore rules.

ul.li: File manager emblems are now live. Nothing is written on your files any more: a Nemo-Python extension asks the running app over a socket what each file shows (synced, syncing, error, paused). A grey "ignored" badge marks .fastsync, unchecked folders and files hidden by ignore rules. Old `metadata::emblems` marks are cleaned up at start. Nemo only; needs python-nemo.
Start at login: new Preferences box. Runs `fastsync --hidden` and stays in the tray. Flatpak uses the Background portal.
Flatpak: the Nemo actions, submenu, icon and emblems are written to the host's folders, and the actions run `flatpak run --share %F`.
Damaged state database is kept as `.bad.` and rebuilt. With no rows it only adopts what matches, never deletes.
New `FileStates` (core) tracks moving and failed files, fed by the engine and the runner; failed files survive a restart.
OneDrive "View on web" fetches `webUrl` from Graph.
Redrawn tray icons (error, paused, syncing) and a new syncing emblem.
Tests, README, FEATURES, ENGINE, AGENTS and pt_BR strings updated.
